programme.title: A l'affiche

programme.title: E2 - Surviving the Flood
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: E1 - Summer Cubs
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: E2 - Surviving the Flood

programme.title: E1 - Lion
programme.desc: Trace the lion’s rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: E1 - Australia
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the world’s most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: E2 - North America
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: E24
programme.desc: 少女陳寶銀為救母親，無奈被卷入命運洪流，從青樓逃落後幾經輾轉成為船娘；在她最落魄時重逢曾救過她的書生溫肅，此時溫肅已家道中落，為救家人忍辱成為長公主的男寵；兩個身處泥潭的底層男女在亂世中相互取暖、彼此救贖，上演了一段充滿破碎感卻又堅韌動人的愛情故事。

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: E5 - Volcanic Kingfish / Kingfish
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for kingfish Rick Pollock . They fish the the coast of Newzealand just off a live Volcano, then tragedy strikes…… after the Volcano erupts mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: E6 - Mountain Monsters / Red Stag
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.

programme.title: E8 - Birds Of A Feather / Duck and Pheasant
programme.desc: Mario must face his fear as he harvests crayfish and abolone during the mating season of the great white sharks. He then heads up into chamois territory in mountain tops of Fiordland. This world heritage area is where the mountains meet the sea, it’s very remote and rugged and the perfect setting for a New Zealand inspired surf and turf dish.

However, on the tropical island of Bali, a collective of designers, craftsmen, and social entrepreneurs is working with indigenous communities in what is known as a restorative economy.

programme.title: Can India Revive Its Repair Culture And Curb E-Waste?
programme.desc: Many Indians used to get electronic goods fixed, but now many products cannot be mended. Some Indians want the right to repair. Plus how a community scheme in a wildlife reserve in Nilgiris is taking on tourist trash.

programme.title: Deep-Sea Fishing In The Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: A state-of-the-art fishing trawler from Cuxhaven sets sail from Tromsoe to hunt for cod. The crew faces six weeks at sea, during which the men must work hard, in shifts around the clock.

programme.title: From Opium To Fentanyl: Do We Keep Falling For The Same Lie?
programme.desc: Some of the world's deadliest drugs once began as 'safe” medicine. From ancient opium to heroin, OxyContin and fentanyl, this video traces how miracle cures became global crises.

programme.title: Old Wisdom, Bold Ideas
programme.desc: Ugandan schools are teaching students about clan totems, plants or animals that are taboo to kill or eat. Aim is to give them a personal stake in conservation. Upcycled art that wants to rewire thinking about e-waste.

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E35
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E34
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: 《今生有你》根據匪我思存的小説《愛你是最好的時光》改編，講述了心外科醫生聶宇晟與曾經的戀人、單親媽媽談靜攜手面對命運，最終迎來幸福人生的故事。

programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E35
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: Hero Of Tomorrow
programme.desc: Sammy is a man of honour. He lives by the underworld's code of honour. He helps friends and kills enemies, for instance, Ng Kong who got him 3 years behind bars. Sammy is now a fugitive in Taiwan being protected by Kui, one of the gang leaders. Once Kui injures Peter, his opposition and young Crow takes the rap. Sammy and Crow become friends. Sammy tries to mediate between Kui and Peter but finds out being used by Kui to eliminate Peter. He wants out. But Crow joins Kui's gang after killing Peter. Sammy retires to Crow's home town and falls in love with his sister. Kui begins to turn against Crow. He sends Crow to Hong Kong and orders to kill him. Crow escapes back to Taiwan, only to find his girlfriend has committed suicide after Kui's gang has raped her. At the same moment, Kui's men come for him and kill his sister who comes with Sammy to deliver their wedding news. With Sammy by his side, Crow starts his vendetta...

programme.title: Yes, Madam!
programme.desc: Senior Police Inspector Ng is assigned to work with another lady inspector from Scotland Yard, to investigate the murder of an agent from the Commercial Crime Bureau of London, who was killed because of the evidence he has collected against a crime syndicate in Hong Kong. As the duo try to work around each other's polarized cultures and background, they kick and punch their way through the investigation, leading to 2 small time pickpockets Strepsil and Panadol, who had stolen the passport containing the evidence from the agent before he died. As the bumbling pickpockets try to dodge the assassins in hot pursuit, they eventually turn to the lady cops for help against the crime boss...

programme.title: Heaven Can Help
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting...

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 擁有雙重面貌卻守節十五年的蒙面寡婦，在白天是個足不出戶、行為謹慎的女人。到了晚上，她就會翻牆出去，戴著面紗去照顧那些有需要的人。在某天晚上卻遇到了追查年幼時慘死的父親死因的男人。這使她開始對未來有所憧憬。但當他們一起捲入一場意想不到的事件時，生活發生了巨大的變化。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。
